summary: Cybin Inc. filed Form 6-K on April 20, 2026, attaching a press release from its commercial operating name, Helus Pharma, expressing support for a White House Executive Order on psychedelic research and regulatory pathways. The press release contains no actionable corporate transaction—no acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or other special situation. It is a routine policy commentary by management. The filing is a standard foreign private issuer report under Rule 13a-16. No deal terms, prices, premiums, or structural changes are mentioned. This is not a special-situation filing.
